# SUL — Regiment Maintenance Increase
#
# Absorbs 75% of manpower building maintenance cost.
# All goods multiplied by x4.37 (uniform across all types).
#
# M = S / avg_d = 3.965 / 1.175 = 3.374
# S = 0.75 × 520 × 0.2 / 19.67 = 3.965
#
# Generated by tools/calculate_maintenance.py
